dns-ruleset-shared-across-vnets.title: One DNS forwarding ruleset can serve many virtual networks
dns-ruleset-shared-across-vnets.body: This estimate has several DNS Private Resolver forwarding rulesets, each billed monthly. A ruleset can be linked to up to 500 virtual networks in the same region, so one ruleset per region is usually enough unless networks need different forwarding rules.

citation.source: Azure DNS Private Resolver endpoints and rulesets
citation.quote: A ruleset can be linked to up to 500 virtual networks in the same region.
